basic.description:
{Basic Luck}

Increases the Luck of all hero's creatures by {1}, improving their chance to deal double damage with lucky strikes.

{Positive Luck} can grant or improve chance-based creature abilities. {Negative Luck} can weaken such abilities.

Additionally, it increases the chance of better rewards from adventure map objects. In creature banks, at this level it provides a {25%} chance for an upgraded reward. In the Pyramid, it provides a {25%} chance to discover an additional random level 4 spell if the hero has {Expert Wisdom}.
